cohort: 1883 Japanese women who delivered singleton infants at Osaka-Minami Medical Center between January 2010 and January 2013
finding: A pre-pregnancy BMI of less than 23 kg/m² was associated with a lower risk of PIH in Japanese women, and GWG within the IOM recommendations was associated with a reduced risk of PIH and SGA infants.
mod_finding: The rate of emergency cesarean section was not significantly different between women with different pre-pregnancy BMI and gestational weight gain categories.
